chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:
Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام said: The Imam gives one taslim, and those behind him give two taslims; but if there is no one on his left, he gives one taslim.

key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the prayer leader in congregational salat
key_terms.بِتَسْلِيمَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ: with one salutation at the end of the prayer
key_terms.يُسَلِّمُ: gives the taslim that concludes the salat

ai.seo_question: How should the Imam and the follower perform the taslim in salat according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the manner of taslim in salat, distinguishing between the Imam and the follower. It states that the Imam gives one taslim, while the person praying behind him gives two, unless there is no one on his left, in which case he gives one.
